list.title: Services

noManager.title: No manager is connected
noManager.body: Swarm changes are off until a manager node's agent reconnects. You can still look at what Bayplan last saw.

list.emptyCreateBody: Services run your containers across the swarm. Create one, or deploy a stack that defines them.

search.label: Search services
search.placeholder: Search by name, image, label or stack

list.cap: Showing the first 500 of {{total, number}}. Narrow the search to see the rest.

bulk.none: None of the selected services can be scaled.

notASwarm.heading: This isn't a swarm
notASwarm.body: {{environment}} is a standalone host, so it has no services, nodes, secrets or configs.

scale.title: Scale {{name}}
scale.body: Set how many tasks should run. It runs {{count, number}} now.
scale.zeroWarning: Scaling to 0 stops every task. The service stays, and you can scale it up again.
scale.stackWarning: {{name}} belongs to stack {{stack}}. The next stack deploy sets its replica count again.

errors.range: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.
errors.service_changed: This service was changed by someone else after it was read. Nothing was changed. Check the list for what it runs now, then scale it again.
errors.service_not_found: This service is gone. It was removed, or a stack deploy replaced it.
errors.no_manager_connected: No manager is connected for {{environment}}, so this swarm can't be changed right now. Reconnect a manager's agent and try again.
errors.no_quorum: The swarm has lost its quorum, so it can't be changed right now. Bring its managers back and try again.
errors.registry_unresolved: Bayplan couldn't read the registry credential for this service's image, so nothing was sent. Check the credential under Registries, then try again.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.

scale.bulkBody: Set how many tasks each service should run.
scale.stackWarningMany_one: {{count}} of these belongs to a stack. The next stack deploy sets its replica count again.
scale.stackWarningMany_other: {{count}} of these belong to stacks. The next stack deploy sets their replica counts again.

problems.agent_host_policy: This swarm's manager agents don't let Bayplan change services with host access. Set BAYPLAN_AGENT_ALLOW_PRIVILEGED_SERVICES=true on them to allow it.

forceUpdate.title: Force update {{name}}?
forceUpdate.body: Swarm replaces every task, a batch at a time, using the service's update settings. Bayplan looks up the image again, so a tag that has moved is picked up.
forceUpdate.stackWarning: {{name}} belongs to stack {{stack}}. The next stack deploy applies the compose file again.

retry.title: Retry the update on {{name}}?
retry.body: Swarm tries the update again with the service's current settings.

rollback.title: Roll back {{name}}?
rollback.body: The service goes back to the settings it had before its last update. Swarm rolls tasks back a batch at a time.
rollback.stackWarning: The next stack deploy applies the compose file again.
rollback.noEarlier: There's no earlier version to roll back to.

refusal.image_unresolved: Couldn't look up {{ref}} on {{host}} to pin it to a digest. Check the name, the tag and the credential, then try again.
refusal.service_changed: This service was changed by someone else after you looked. Nothing was changed. Close this and open it again to see what it runs now.
refusal.service_not_found: This service is gone. It was removed, or a stack deploy replaced it.
refusal.no_manager_connected: No manager is connected for {{environment}}, so this swarm can't be changed right now. Reconnect a manager's agent and try again.
refusal.no_quorum: The swarm has lost its quorum, so it can't be changed right now. Bring its managers back and try again.
refusal.registry_unresolved: Bayplan couldn't read the registry credential for this service's image, so nothing was sent. Check the credential under Registries, then try again.
refusal.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
refusal.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.
refusal.rollback_object_missing: Can't roll back: {{object}} no longer exists. Create it again or edit the service instead.
